items.title: Albert Glenny Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Well, he didn't know his brother. Andre.

ctx.x: Tell us some more about those clubs over in Storyville. Like what is Tom Anderson's like inside?

He means in the district. Oh! I played with Anderson. I played with him. I played with him on the right part between Canal and Abraville. On that side of the back. Anderson. I played with him. I mean this fellow, Paul Dominguez. I know him at Dwyer. You know him? He heard all of him. He did Paul Dyer too, you know. Paul Dominguez? What's Paul then? I didn't know that. Yeah, since Paul Dyer, he was a good bass player. He was the one who gave me a friendly good actor. He played violin too. Oh yeah, Paul used to…
